```{=html}
<div class="category-dropdown-wrap">
  <select id="cat-select" onchange="filterCategory(this.value)">
    <option value="all">Toutes les catégories</option>
  </select>
</div>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const select = document.getElementById("cat-select");
  const links = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category a.category");
  links.forEach(function (link) {
    const val = link.getAttribute("data-listing-category") || link.textContent.trim();
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = val;
    opt.textContent = val;
    select.appendChild(opt);
  });
});

function filterCategory(val) {
  if (val === "all") {
    const allLink = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category a.category[data-listing-category='']") ||
                    document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category a.category");
    if (allLink) { allLink.click(); }
    return;
  }
  const links = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category a.category");
  links.forEach(function (link) {
    const cat = link.getAttribute("data-listing-category") || link.textContent.trim();
    if (cat === val) { link.click(); }
  });
}
</script>
```
